# Hor Tongan

> Personal portfolio and project directory for Hor Tongan, an IT student at The University of Cambodia building web applications, desktop tools, Android games, and terminal software.

## Overview

Hor Tongan builds software across Python, Java, Kotlin, C++, JavaScript, and SQL. His projects emphasize offline functionality, clean architecture, and lightweight performance without unnecessary framework bloat.

- Website: https://tongan.dev/
- GitHub: https://github.com/tonganwashere
- Telegram: https://t.me/tonganwashere
- Facebook: https://facebook.com/TongAnWasHere
- CV: https://tongan.dev/cv/

## Pages

- [Home](https://tongan.dev/): Portfolio landing page and featured project showcases.
- [Projects](https://tongan.dev/projects/): Complete directory of software projects.
- [About](https://tongan.dev/about/): Background, education, technical achievements, and skills.
- [CV](https://tongan.dev/cv/): Curriculum Vitae with PDF download.

## Featured Projects

- [Genera](https://tongan.dev/projects/genera/): flashcard web app built with vanilla JavaScript, Flask, and SQLite. Works offline and features ~4,500 trivia questions, 5-box Leitner spaced repetition, local IndexedDB storage, service worker caching, and multi-device sync with conflict resolution.
  - GitHub: https://github.com/tonganwashere/genera
  - Live Demo: https://genera-bvzb.onrender.com/
- [Proctor](https://tongan.dev/projects/proctor/): Terminal-based examination, quiz, and question bank management platform built in Java with MVC architecture, PostgreSQL, and local AI (Ollama) integration.
  - GitHub: https://github.com/tonganwashere/proctor
- [PyDFile](https://tongan.dev/projects/pydfile/): Offline desktop PDF management suite built in Python with CustomTkinter, PyMuPDF, and pikepdf, packaged as a standalone Windows executable.
  - GitHub: https://github.com/tonganwashere/pydfile
- [Pitch Flip](https://tongan.dev/projects/pitch_flip/): Android 3D coin flip application built in Kotlin, rendered using OpenGL ES 2.0 with customizable skins and flip physics.
  - GitHub: https://github.com/tonganwashere/pitch_flip
- [Wordle++](https://tongan.dev/projects/wordlepp/): Terminal word-guessing game in C++ using FTXUI with multiple game modes (3, 5, 6 letters and daily challenge), streaks, and an admin panel.
  - GitHub: https://github.com/tonganwashere/wordle_plus_plus
